title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
abstract: arXiv:2611.09709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RidgeFill shortens prefill by not computing most of a model's upper layers for the prompt. The lower layers run exactly up to a split; from the split layer's state a per-layer map predicts every later layer's input, and each late layer writes its cache from that prediction. The design follows YOCO and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, where the projection is trained into the model. RidgeFill retrofits it onto models that were never trained for it: the map is a ridge regression fitted once in closed form from one pass over calibration text, the layer's own projections run unchanged, and a chosen set of rows, the last few thousand tokens, and every decoding step run the full model. Nothing is trained and no token is dropped.   Most of the work was in measurement, finding a repeatable methodology. Loss averaged over all tokens hides RidgeFill's error. Needle retrieval in the filled region, loss on tokens that depend on distant context, and splice test

translated_title: RidgeFill：免训练的晚层缓存填充以加速预填充
translated_abstract: RidgeFill 通过不为提示词计算模型的大部分上层来缩短预填充。下层精确运行至一个分割点；从分割层的状态出发，一个逐层映射预测每个后续层的输入，每个晚层根据该预测写入其缓存。该设计遵循 YOCO 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，在后两者中投影是通过模型训练习得的。RidgeFill 则将此机制改造到从未为此训练过的模型上：该映射是一个岭回归，通过对校准文本进行一次前向遍历以闭式解一次性拟合得到；层自身的投影保持原样运行；选定的一组行、最后几千个 token 以及每个解码步骤都运行完整模型。整个过程无需任何训练，也不丢弃任何 token。大部分工作在于测量方面，即寻找可重复的评估方法：对所有 token 平均的损失会掩盖 RidgeFill 的误差，而填充区域内的“大海捞针”检索、依赖远距离上下文 token 上的损失以及拼接测试（下文截断）
tldr: RidgeFill 提出一种免训练方法，通过从一次校准数据中以闭式解拟合的岭回归映射，由分割层状态直接预测并填充模型晚层的 KV 缓存，从而跳过预填充阶段大部分上层的计算，在不重训模型、不丢弃 token 的情况下加速推理。
en_tdlr: RidgeFill introduces a training-free method that fits a closed-form ridge regression map from one calibration pass to predict and fill late-layer KV caches from a split layer's state, skipping computation of most upper layers during prefill to speed up inference without retraining the model or dropping any tokens.
